Episode 247. Liberation War of Lafrarosa (1)
The second liberation device had just been completed. Garmund and Teto had seamlessly blended with the alliance just as the previous Battle Kings had. They too shed tears upon hearing about Jin.
They also provided news from within Lafrarosa.

By the time they left, Lafrarosa was already missing Beliz and Linpa. Furthermore, the effects of the dimensional error were accelerating, and the enemies were intensifying their onslaught. The situation couldn't be good.
"...Now that both the Garmund brothers and the Teto brothers are gone, Lafrarosa will undoubtedly face more challenges."
Worry was evident on the faces of Beliz and Linpa, who always told others not to worry.
It wasn't just because of Vahn. They were concerned if the remaining eight pairs of Battle Kings could hold on.
"Come on, who's going to die? Honestly, I don't know about the Garmund brothers, but the Teto brothers are the weakest among us, right? Their absence might not be that noticeable."
"Hey, Beliz brothers, that remark deeply wounds my heart."
"But... it's true..."
"Yeah, the Teto brothers are still excellent Battle Kings. He’s just the least among the best."
"With the Linpa brothers and the Garmund brothers too? Damn it, I'm still a Battle King. Come on, Jin brothers, say something."
"From now on, the Battle God brothers probably won't send any more of the Battle King brothers, even if there's an opportunity."
Jin said, looking around at his colleagues. Teto tried to argue that wasn't what he meant, but he closed his mouth after sensing the atmosphere.
"Why do you think that, Jin brothers?"

"The Battle God brothers trust me and the brothers. In my opinion, sending out more of the Battle King brothers will endanger the other brothers' lives. Plus, the Battle God brothers have probably roughly grasped the enemy's abilities by now, and already shown her might."
Jin was confident. Hearing this, the other Battle Kings paused in thought and then nodded in agreement.
"That's right, the Battle God brothers don't just favor the Jin brothers. She will act only when everyone can move together."

"Anyway, from the beginning, we planned the operation without the four Battle King brothers here. With you brothers added, our chances of success have increased. The Battle God brothers have given us enough support. Now it's up to us."
"Hehe, so we just need to throw this box beyond the dimensional rift?"
Teto said, pointing at the liberation device.
"Right. Until it's done."
"Yes, until it's done!"
The Battle for the Mitra Desert, fought until the liberation device was completed, could be considered a victory for the Red Plutonian.
They had continued to occupy the desert until now. The Vamel Alliance never once took control of the desert from them.
However, they hadn’t lost the war yet.
Whether the Plutonian would be liberated or the rift destroyed beforehand, the outcome of the Lafrarosa Liberation War would hinge on these events.

The Vamel Alliance was planning to head to the desert as soon as they received a scouting report from Nameless. The designated team was the same as last time: three units, but with Garmund and Teto added in place of the injured Owl.
Wooong-!
The communication device in the meeting room vibrated. It was a communication request from Nameless.
{Young master, it's Bizhen from Nameless’ chief assassins.}
Urgency tinged Bizhen's voice. Jin and his colleagues leaned in closely to the communicator, their expressions tightening.
"Bizhen, what happened?"
{...It's chaos.}
"Chaos!?"

{A massive storm of chaos has suddenly erupted in the area of Lafrarosa's rift occupied by the Red Plutonian. It's still expanding. Even though communication is cut off in some areas, it's visible to the naked eye.}
The chaos that started from the orb that Lokia gave to Shimat was spreading uncontrollably like a wildfire.
"Ganesto...! They've intervened."
Jin immediately thought of Ganesto. Currently, the only one using the power of chaos to this extent was Ganesto.
'I expected this, but why now... And the scale of the chaos is not normal. What have they done?'
Whatever it was, it certainly wasn't for the benefit of Lafrarosa and the Vamel Alliance. Jin took a moment to suppress his anger and cool down his head.
"Was there any other unusual activity?"
{I couldn't check in detail because I was avoiding the Red Plutonian energy waves and the chaos. If you permit, I will re-enter now.}
"No, all Nameless assassins in the desert should return immediately."
{Understood.}
The communication ended. Jin exchanged glances with his colleagues and quickly began adjusting their plans.
"Jet, prepare the chaos purification device immediately and send it to Dr. Qwaul. Make sure it's ready for use after inspection. And call Murakan and Bale on your way out."
"Understood, my lord!"
"Lord Talaris, it would be best for you to return to the Castle for now."
"Hmm, are you thinking of changing the infiltration team?"

"Yes. There's no rule saying the chaos can only spread in the desert. Furthermore, we can't predict how the Red Plutonian will react at this moment. They could potentially attack our territories while the desert is consumed by chaos."
"You're right, son-in-law. The fortress will be hard to defend without me."
"Dante, you should return to the empire. Lady Vanessa, head to the Garden of Swords."
"Got it."
"Understood, Young master."
"Sister Luna will remain in Tikan."
"Huh? Little brother, am I being left out of the infiltration team? Then how are you planning to organize the team?"

"Those at high risk of exposure to the chaos will all be excluded. Of course, those with power above 10 stars might be able to withstand and fight amidst the chaos, but they could also become sources of contamination. Especially lethal for us, as we are on the defense."
During the times of the Castle of Evil God war and the Sword Emperor city, Jin was the only one immune to chaos.
But that's not the case now.
The entire Plutonian has been immune to chaos since their birth. There were five such kings of the Plutonian present in the room.
"Ah, Jin. You called me again to nag, didn't you? Mentioning that there's a gap in Tikan's aerial defense. Do you think it's easy to maintain a shield over Tikan all day?"
"You're here, Heaven Fated Enemy (필천적). The defense you've been handling will be taken over by Lady Luna and the superhumans who've been excluded this time. You're coming to the desert with me."
The Fragment of the Sun God, Bale.
He was also practically immune to the chaos.
"Oh... has the time come for Bale himself to grant eternal rest to those with red radiant hearts? Haha, a blood festival indeed."
Amid the tense atmosphere, Bale's joke managed to make everyone chuckle, although it might not have been a joke at all.
"Hey kid, what about me? I was waiting for your strawberry pie as a reward for my hard work. How will you make it up to me?"
Following Bale, Murakan entered the conference room. His scales, which had regained most of their glory, were strong enough to resist even the potent chaos.
"You're infiltrating this time, too. We need members who face almost no risk of chaos exposure."
"What? Then what about Tikan? Immortal Heaven Fated Enemy is here too, is he joining the infiltration?"
"Ha, Immortal Heaven Fated Enemy, why you keep calling me that, just pick one."
"If both Heaven Fated Enemy and I are absent, there will inevitably be gaps, even with other superhumans replacing us."
"Can't help it. Given the situation, we have to take a gamble. Even if the Red Plutonian attacks Tikan, we can hold out until the infiltration team returns."
"Tsk, fine. Strawberry pie, just wait a bit. I'll go and kill them all, ah, it's annoying! It's been a while since I had to enforce discipline myself, damn those Red Plutonian bastards."
"The strawberry pie isn't even here, friend Murakan!"
"Even if she is not here, the thought counts! Friend Beliz. Now that you Plutonian are in this world, I suggest you try falling in love."
"Lastly, I'm going with the youngest too. Hehe."
Yona said as she crawled out from under the desk. Nobody knew she had been hiding there until now.
"Whoa, Yona. You're not immune to chaos, are you?"
"Not completely immune, but I can control it a bit. And I need to be there to move the liberation device around."

Even if a sudden storm of chaos has arisen, the coalition's goal hasn't changed. If the Red Plutonians decide to battle in the storm of chaos, they will intercept the liberation device even more tenaciously than before.
Jin, Beliz, Linpa, Garmund, Teto, Murakan, Bale, Yona.
This sortie was decided with these eight. It was the first time both Jin and Murakan were deployed at the same time, and also the first time all four Battle Kings were in perfect condition.

"The numbers have decreased, but maybe this is better. Plus, according to Lord Eltiot, the Red Plutonian and Plutonian don't have as strong an immunity to chaos as my brothers and I do. The chaos might even work to our advantage."

Furthermore, as Kinzelo mentioned during the summoning, the chaos used by Ganesto might have a positive effect on the rift of Lafrarosa. So far, things have been happening due to coincidences and errors.
"Let's go."
Jin and his colleagues mounted the red owl. In an instant, the red owl transported them to the outskirts of the desert.
"Ugh."
"Are you okay, friend Murakan!?"
"I'm fine."
"Just leave him be for a bit, brother Teto."
Beyond the full-window view, the proliferating storm of chaos could be seen. For Murakan, Bale, and Yona, it was just a massive chaos without any distinct features.
However, as soon as Jin and the Battle Kings faced the chaos, they collectively held their foreheads.
"Ah! Why does it have to be that chaos?"
"The original chaos. It's going to be tough if it's not a complete immunity."
"That is... not common... Why does Jin brother, keep getting... entangled with that chaos?"
"We're lucky it's just us here. Other friends would find it hard to fight as long as we can amidst that."
The Battle Kings said. However, contrary to their words, there was no sign of them being disheartened.

"…Lingling. That chaos is surely released to provoke Lingling, brothers. It seems the Ganesto bastards found out about the connection between Lingling and Vahn Brother. I don't know what method they used."
Gritting their teeth, Jin and the Battle Kings simultaneously wielded their weapons.
